b0h4wlychz.name: 600 CFM Cordless Leaf Blower for Milwaukee M18, Tool Only
b0h4wlychz.bestFor: Clearing light dry snow and debris with M18 batteries
b0h4wlychz.description:
This is a handheld leaf blower made to run on Milwaukee M18 batteries, listed with up to 600 cubic feet per minute of air and 125 miles per hour wind speed. It weighs only 3.5 pounds, has a trigger with a cruise control lever, and is sold as a bare tool. It is a leaf blower, not a snow blower, so it belongs here only as an accessory.

Compared with the STEELITE and EGO machines in this guide, it cannot cut or throw packed snow. It can push a light dusting of dry flakes off a car, a porch or a step. Against the cordless snow shovel, it offers no scooping at all, only air.

For older owners who already have M18 batteries, the light weight is a real plus for one handed use. Wear eye protection and gloves, and keep a fully charged battery inside until needed. Expect to buy a battery and charger if you do not own them, and do not rely on it for a heavy storm.
pros: Light at about 3.5 pounds for one handed use
Cruise control lever locks the trigger
Strong airflow for dry flakes and debris
cons: A leaf blower, not a real snow blower
Battery and charger are not included

b0fkzxz8fw.name: 12 inch Cordless Electric Snow Shovel with Adjustable Handle
b0fkzxz8fw.bestFor: Small porches, steps and short paths
b0fkzxz8fw.description:
This cordless electric snow shovel clears a path 12 to 16 inches wide and about 8 inches deep, with an adjustable lever to set the handle length. The listing says it works for both outdoor and indoor use, and asks for a full first charge. The product details are brief, so check battery size on the page.

It is a shovel rather than a blower, so it handles lighter snow in smaller areas than the STEELITE 20 inch or the EGO 21 inch blowers in this guide. It appears here as the compact pick because it is lighter and easier to store. It does not throw snow far.

Older owners will like that there is no gas, pull cord or heavy frame. Walk forward in short passes and let the machine do the pushing. Charge the battery indoors, and expect to clear only a few inches at a time.
pros: Cordless, with no gas or pull cord
Easy to store in a closet
cons: A shovel, not a throwing snow blower
Limited detail about battery and runtime

b0fvxz764k.name: Cordless Leaf Blower for Milwaukee 18V Max, 4.0Ah Battery
b0fvxz764k.bestFor: Dusting snow off cars and steps
b0fvxz764k.description:
This compact cordless blower is built to run on Milwaukee 18 volt batteries, with a listed speed up to 180 miles per hour and an axial flow design. It ships with a standard tube and a flat nozzle that clips on in one step. The listing describes it as ultra portable and light.

It is a leaf blower, so it cannot replace the STEELITE or EGO blowers in this guide for anything deeper than a light dusting. The speed figure suggests it can move dry snow off a windshield. Against the other leaf blower in the guide, it is smaller.

Older owners will find the small size easy to lift. Keep the nozzle pointed away from your face, and wear gloves. Do not expect it to clear packed snow, and plan to use a real shovel or snow blower for storms.
pros: Compact and light for easy handling
Axial flow design with high air speed
Flat nozzle snaps on in one click
cons: A leaf blower, so it will not clear deep snow
Battery use drains quickly at full speed

b0hhqj586v.name: STEELITE 40V Cordless Snow Blower, 20 inch
b0hhqj586v.bestFor: Driveways and walkways with light to moderate snow
b0hhqj586v.description:
The STEELITE is a 40 volt snow blower that runs on two 20 volt batteries and clears a 20 inch swath. It weighs about 26 pounds, has built in LED lights, and a 180 degree adjustable chute for aiming snow. The listing says it is made to stand up to harsh winter use.

In this guide it is the heavy use pick, though at 26 pounds it is a light single stage machine. Against the EGO 21 inch with 40 foot throw, it is simpler and lighter. Compared with the cordless shovel, it clears a wider path.

Older owners will find that a 26 pound machine is easy to push and store. The LED lights help for early morning clearing. Work in overlapping passes, and keep batteries warm before use. For deep, heavy snow, step up to a stronger model.
pros: Only 26 pounds, easy to push and store
Built in LED lights for dim mornings
cons: Not suited to deep, wet snow
Needs two batteries for full power

b09fq2wskk.name: EGO Power+ 21 inch Cordless Snow Blower
b09fq2wskk.description:
The EGO Power+ 21 inch snow blower combines the power of two 56 volt ARC lithium batteries with a steel auger and an efficient brushless motor. The listing says it throws snow up to 40 feet and cuts through ice and snow 50 percent faster than its previous design. Its clearing width is 21 inches.

It is the premium pick in this guide. Against the STEELITE, it offers a wider swath and a longer throw, along with a steel auger that bites into packed snow. Against the shovel and leaf blower picks, it is the only true snow blower with real throwing distance.

Older owners will like that it replaces a gas machine with no pull starting. Wear non slip boots, and keep the chute pointed away from people. Charge the batteries before the first storm, and plan to clear snow soon after it falls.
pros: Steel auger cuts ice and packed snow
Peak Power uses two 56 volt batteries
cons: Batteries add cost if not included
Heavier and larger than a shovel type tool

b0gkdkktt7.name: GoGuess 34 Pint Dehumidifier, 2,500 sq ft
b0gkdkktt7.bestFor: Larger rooms and basements, not truly mini
b0gkdkktt7.description:
The GoGuess dehumidifier is rated for 2,500 square feet and 34 pints of daily removal. It has DEHU, TURBO and SLEEP modes, a visual humidity display and quiet operation at 40 dB. The listing offers both manual and continuous drainage.

It is the premium pick but not a mini dehumidifier, since it is the largest unit in this guide. Compared with the Eva-Dry E-333, it is a compressor machine with a real tank and hose option. Against the TABYIK 35 ounce units, it removes far more water and covers more floor area.

Older owners should use the continuous drain hose to avoid lifting a full tank. Keep it away from walls, clean the filter regularly, and set it to the SLEEP mode for bedrooms. It is a good fit for a damp basement.
pros: Rated for rooms up to 2,500 square feet
cons: Not a mini unit and needs floor space
Higher running cost than small desiccant models

b000h0xfcs.name: Eva-Dry E-333 Wireless Mini Dehumidifier
b000h0xfcs.bestFor: Closets, cabinets and small damp corners
b000h0xfcs.description:
The Eva-Dry E-333 is a small cordless dehumidifier that uses a renewable desiccant instead of a compressor. The listing says the unit lasts 20 to 30 days between recharges, and it has no cord, no spills and no mess. It can hang in a closet or sit on a shelf.

Compared with the GoGuess and Pro Breeze units, it has no fan, no tank and no electric draw while working. It removes far less moisture, so it suits closets and gun safes rather than whole rooms. It is the value pick here because it is cheap to run.

Older owners will like that there is nothing to empty or plug in. When the indicator shows it is full, plug it in to dry out the desiccant. Place it away from children and pets, and expect to recharge it often in humid months.
pros: No cord and nothing to empty
Lasts about 20 to 30 days between recharges
Hangs or sits in small spaces
cons: Handles only tiny spaces
Must be recharged on a regular schedule

b09tsztmz2.name: TABYIK 35 oz Mini Dehumidifier for Bedrooms and RVs
b09tsztmz2.description:
The TABYIK is a mini dehumidifier with a 1000 milliliter transparent tank and an automatic shutoff when the tank is about 700 to 800 milliliters full. It measures roughly 5.9 by 5.9 by 10.1 inches and has a built in handle. A separate button toggles a seven color light.

Compared with the Pro Breeze, it has a similar size and also uses a small cooling plate. Against the Eva-Dry, it plugs in and removes water into a tank. Against the GoGuess, it is far smaller and weaker.

Older owners can see the water level through the clear tank and carry the unit by the handle. Empty it every day or two, and wipe it dry before storage. It suits single rooms of modest size, not a damp basement.
pros: Automatic shutoff when the tank fills
cons: Small tank needs frequent emptying
Weak against heavy humidity

b0cmtp3gh8.name: TABYIK 35 oz Dehumidifier, Second Listing
b0cmtp3gh8.bestFor: Small rooms where an easy to carry unit is wanted
b0cmtp3gh8.description:
This listing looks like the same TABYIK 35 ounce dehumidifier as the other entry. It has a 1000 milliliter clear tank, auto shutoff when the tank is about 700 to 800 milliliters full, and a built in handle. The compact body is about 5.9 by 5.9 by 10.1 inches.

Because it duplicates the other TABYIK pick, treat the two as one product. Compare seller, return terms and bundled extras before choosing. Against the GoGuess, it covers much less, and against the Eva-Dry, it uses power but removes more water.

Older owners should place it on a flat surface in a small room, and empty the tank before it shuts off. Keep doors closed and clean the tank weekly.
pros: Same compact design as the other TABYIK
cons: Duplicate of another listing in this guide
Limited capacity for large rooms

b01dc5ppwm.name: Pro Breeze Mini Dehumidifier, 215 sq ft, 17 oz
b01dc5ppwm.bestFor: Small rooms such as bathrooms and bedrooms
b01dc5ppwm.description:
The Pro Breeze mini dehumidifier is rated for about 215 square feet and has a 17 ounce tank. The maker describes it as whisper quiet and suited to kitchens, bathrooms, bedrooms and RVs. It uses a small cooling plate instead of a compressor.

It is the heavy use pick in this guide, though its capacity is modest. Compared with the TABYIK, it has a smaller tank, and compared with the Eva-Dry, it needs power. The GoGuess is the only unit that handles large basements.

Older owners will like the quiet running and light weight. Empty the tank daily in humid weather and wipe it dry. Expect it to help with a single room, not a whole house.
cons: Small tank fills quickly
Limited to about 215 square feet
